title: Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage: Share Carried from the Previous Coinsurance Block for Card Payments
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — the earlier share.** The block before the paid block is the coverage's booked-days entry in the band of benefit days 21 through 100 whose last benefit day is the day before the paid block's first benefit day; its resident charge is the resident coinsurance charge posted for it that is not a rebill of a denied secondary share. The earlier share the card payment applies is read from the block before: 50 percent when its resident charge bills half of that charge's own days times its own daily rate, to within half a percentage point; 25 percent when it bills a quarter, to within half a percentage point; 0 percent when the block before carries a secondary charge and no resident charge; and 100 percent otherwise.

### Questions this rule answers

**Which block is "the block before"?** The booked-days entry of the same coverage, in the band of benefit days 21 through 100, whose last benefit day is exactly one less than the paid block's first benefit day.

**Which charge on it is read?** Its resident charge — the resident coinsurance charge posted for that block that is not a rebill of a denied secondary share. The share it billed is that charge's amount set against its own day count times its own daily rate.

**What does the share decide?** The share taken by the days the card payment counts before the supplemental effective date.

*Hypothetical worked example:* the block before carries a resident charge of 663.00 for 13 days at a recorded daily rate of 204.00. Thirteen times 204.00 is 2652.00; 663.00 is 25 percent of 2652.00 to within half a percentage point, so the earlier share is 25 percent.
